name: Stat Reel
tagline: Turn 3–6 real numbers into a vertical reel: each stat gets the right chart, counts up and shows its source.
youSay: /stat-reel Our 2026 in five numbers: 12,400 teams, 38% more deep work, planning down from 4.1 to 1.2 hours a week…
whatYouGet: A 15–30 second reel: a title card, one scene per number and an end card
The chart picked from each stat: a counter, a ring, before-and-after bars with the change worked out, columns over time, a ranking or parts of a whole
Three themes: wrapped colour blocks, a ledger report, a night glow
MP4 in 9:16, 16:9 and 1:1, with every source on screen and every scale starting at zero
goodFit: Investor updates, impact reports and metrics announcements
youBring: 3–6 real numbers, what each measures and where it comes from
A title, your brand, URL and a closing line
needs: Google Chrome or Edge (or Playwright's Chromium)

network.purpose: playwright-core for the renderer, installed once
